name: VulnHub
description: Provides downloadable vulnerable virtual machines for offline practice. Community-driven through shared solutions and difficulty ratings.

peerReview.processDescription: VMs submitted by security professionals and community members. VulnHub curates and hosts VMs with varying difficulty levels. Community creates and shares write-ups, providing peer validation of solutions.

attribution.attributionNotes: No formal certifications. Skill validation through community recognition and write-up quality.

povsAlignment.description: Tool development / benchmarking through community-curated vulnerable VMs.
